purpose: Teach: 国費/楽勝/解法/在職/使い物/引換/節減/棄権

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 国費補助の申請書を整えましょう
lines.en: Let's get the national subsidy application together.
lines.style: Efficient and clear. Matter-of-fact opening. Businesslike pace, no flourish. The tone of someone moving through a checklist with quiet purpose.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新入社員の研修は今回楽勝でしたね
lines.en: Yes. The new staff training went smoothly this time.
lines.style: Affirming and straightforward. Light warmth in the acknowledgment. Quick, responsive delivery—following her lead without hesitation or resistance.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 業務効率化の解法を考案しましょう
lines.en: Let's think through a solution for improving our operational efficiency.
lines.style: Steady, directive tone. Slight lift on the opening word to draw attention. Measured pace—this is important work, not rushed. Collaborative in phrasing, authoritative in delivery.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。長期在職社員のキャリア面談を設定します
lines.en: Yes. I'll schedule career development conversations with our longer-term staff.
lines.style: Supportive and engaged. Quick, ready response. The tone of someone who understands the task and is already moving to execute it. Slight nod in the voice.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 古い備品で使い物にならない物は処分しましょう
lines.en: Let's dispose of the old equipment that's no longer usable.
lines.style: Direct and practical. Decisive opening. No-nonsense pace. The voice of someone who has seen waste and wants it gone—firm but not harsh.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。記念品の引換期限を再確認しました
lines.en: Yes. I've double-checked the deadline for the employee gift vouchers.
lines.style: Reliable and assured. Calm confirmation. The pace of someone who has already done the work. Brief, competent, ready for the next task.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 経費の節減目標を設定しましょう
lines.en: Let's set a cost reduction target.
lines.style: Purposeful and lean. Crisp opening attack. Fast, efficient pace—no padding in the language or delivery. Strategic in tone, not bureaucratic.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。総会の議決を棄権しないよう周知します
lines.en: Yes. I'll make sure everyone knows not to abstain on the shareholder vote.
lines.style: Professional and clear. Steady pace. The voice of someone tying up the final detail with precision. Slight emphasis on the importance—this matters, don't miss it.
